How dailies work

Every day brings a new puzzle, rotating through all 40 puzzles. Everyone gets the same puzzle on the same day.

Two difficulties: Easy is the default size, Hard is the largest size. Each has its own streak.

Show solution is hidden for dailies — either you solve it or you don't. Every recorded daily solve is a legit solve.

Attempt plays today's puzzle for that difficulty. If you leave mid-attempt, it saves — come back and Continue picks up exactly where you left off. Attempts from earlier months are dropped.

Play again replays a solved daily for fun; your first solve stands.

Practice plays the difficulty's preset as an ordinary game — a fresh random puzzle, solution available, nothing recorded. Good for warming up.

Streaks count consecutive days with a solve, per difficulty. Miss a day and the streak resets.

Tap Stats for the calendar — it has its own explanation there.

The header shows each difficulty's current streak, longest streak, and total days solved.

The calendar

Each day's left half is Easy and right half is Hard. A check means solved, an arrow means in progress, blank means not started. A gold border means both solved. A played day gets a shaded tile; an unplayed day stays flat and dim. A cyan ring marks today, a border marks the selected day. Tap any day for details.

Use the arrows beside the month name to look back at past months; past months are view-only.

You can continue an in-progress attempt from an earlier day this month; finishing it counts for that day. Solved and untouched past days are view-only.

The Per puzzle tab

Choose a puzzle to see your best time on each preset, and which presets you haven't completed yet. Its Starred section is the same list as the main menu's Starred section.
